about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a full-stack software engineer who loves turning ideas into production-ready products. I work across the entire stack — building performant React front-ends, robust Node.js back-ends, and reliable cloud infrastructure. I care about clean architecture, good developer experience, and shipping fast without breaking things.
